description:
About the company
 Our client is a healthcare technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as the engineering lead for software rollouts at client sites, building, launching and maintaining production language-model applications alongside the client's own teams. A meaningful share of the work involves travel to customer locations.
 What you'll do
 - Own the technical delivery of AI system deployments at customer sites from start to finish.
 - Work directly with client teams to build, launch and operate production language-model applications.
 - Design backend architecture that connects AI components to client systems and data sources.
 - Integrate with client platforms through APIs and standard data formats.
 - Monitor live systems and resolve production issues quickly.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Track record of hands-on engineering work alongside clients or partner organizations, for instance in deployment, solutions or client-facing development.
 - Experience shipping large language model or agent systems to production using Python.
 - Experience building and running backend or AI systems in production, including APIs and data pipelines.
 - Steady tenure of at least two years at past employers, or advancement within one organization.
 - Previous employment at a leading AI-native firm.
 - Willingness to travel 30 to 40 percent of the time to client sites.
 - Computer science degree from a selected university list.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with electronic health record integrations and healthcare data standards.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 200,000 per year
 - Health insurance
 Location and work model
 - United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
